title: Comparative stability of the solid electrolyte interphase in potassium and sodium batteries
content:
Energy Adv., 2026, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5YA00173K, Communication
Open Access

Jan Felix Schuster, Le Anh Ma, Christopher A. O’Keefe, Clare P. Grey, Reza Younesi
The solid electrolyte interphase (SEI) stability is higher in 1 M NaPF6 compared to 1 M KPF6 in common carbonate solvents. Battery electrolyte SEI stability was investigated by model systems and chemical analysis of the surface and electrolyte.
